ida: Onboarding Cytos7B — converter finished but we see token-stride offset in the KV cache. Generation drifts vs upstream after ~1024 tokens, looks like an indexing shift. Anyone run into this pattern?

sam: Seen something similar when a tokenizer silently inserts a BOS/sentinel. Usually a one-off in kv index that accumulates. Can you paste the converter flags + a short repro?

ida: Repro steps: convert with our tool + runtime test. Command: `./convert --model cytos7b.safetensors --tokenizer hf-cytos --headmap swap`
Logs snippet:```
kv_cache_index: expected 0..1023, observed 1..1024
token_ids: [502, 17, 845, ...] (trimmed)
converter flags: --merge-sentinels --headwise-swap
```

marco: That kv index shift screams hidden prefix token. Did you run `tokenizer.encode` on the exact raw bytes? Some tokenizers produce an explicit BOS token (0) while HF ones omit it, causing off-by-one. Also check NFKC normalizer.

ida: tokenizer.encode("") returns [0] on the Cytos tokenizer, while hf-cytos tokenizer returns [] — so there is a hidden BOS.

sam: @ida can you re-run convert with `--preserve_bos` and also try the int4 quant path? Quantization masks sometimes expose different alignment behavior.

ida: Kicking off both now. infra-bot: start test run

infra-bot: orc-test-runner: job 8421 queued -> started on pool-gpu-small. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/8421 (internal)

aya: I opened a tiny conversion patch to optionally strip single-token BOS when present: https://git.redwood/conv/pulls/128 (WIP). Might be a fast stopgap.

marco: Be careful — some models intentionally use a leading sentinel to anchor rotary phase. Stripping could shift phase alignment and push the breakage further out. We should validate per-head rotary phase after any change.

ida: Update from preserve_bos=true run: KV indices align (0..1023) and the immediate drift disappears, but divergence now appears after ~2048 tokens instead of 1024. That suggests a head-phase wrap/rotary-base mismatch compounded with the BOS insertion.

sam: If divergence moves with preserved BOS, that points to rotary frequency / base mismatch. Try forcing the runtime rotary_base to 10000 and compare traces; also run per-head phase consistency check across heads.

ida: Will try rotary_base=10000 next. Short-term mitigation plan: set post-convert flag `strip_bos=true` for Cytos7B fleet and runtime mapping `rotary_base:10000` to stabilize serving while we triage.

ida: Filing onboarding ticket ML-1829 with notes, repro commands, and logs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
notes: thread about tokenizer BOS causing KV index offset and interacting with rotary phase; short convo with infra-bot and small patch link
